segments.title: The forgetting problem
segments.shortTitle: Why early AI forgot the start of sentences

items.text: The learning signal fades at every step back
After many words, it has almost vanished
So plain RNNs forget the start of long sentences

segments.shortTitle: Quick quiz: what does an RNN remember?

props.question: What does an RNN pass from one word to the next?
options: Its hidden state, a kind of memory
props.explain: The hidden state carries what it has read so far.

points: An RNN reads one word at a time
